[attribute-encoding]
=== `@encoding` XInclude Encoding

The encoding to use for the resource being included. The encoding attribute has no effect when the parse attribute value “`parse="xml"`” is set on the <<element-xi-include,`<xi:include>`>> element. See the W3C XInclude documentation (https://www.w3.org/TR/xinclude/).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-xi-include,`<xi:include>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| A valid encoding name.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
